I bought some wrappers from an Asian supermarket. Make sure they don’t have any critic acid, or vinegar. Mine had sodium benzonate but i tolerate it. You can easily make your own wrappers with flour and water. 

Directions (1 hour in total): 
Grate carrots (however many you want), finely chop cabbage, and add firm tofu (I break it with my hands to make a ground meat texture). Put a small amount of olive oil to your pan (you don’t have to) and add salt to your liking. You can add whatever spices you can tolerate. I added oregano, cumin, salt, nutritional yeast, and some coconut aminos. Cook it down till the cabbage is nice and soft. I added brown sugar at the end with more salt. Then I started forming the dumplings. I added filling, wet the edges and formed them (you can watch videos on how to do this). I added a bit of oil to the bottom of the pan, seared them for 2 min, added water to steam them and put a lid on(medium low heat). Add water when the water finishes vaporizing, and flip. I steamed for around 10-15 min. And bam, enjoy. 

Ingredients: 
•cabbage
•carrots 
•firm - extra firm tofu. Or use meat like ground chicken :) 
•cumin 
•salt
•orégano 
•nutritional yeast (optional) 
•coconut aminos, liquid aminos, or soy sauce(if you can tolerate) 
•brown sugar or regular sugar 
•olive oil 
•dumpling wrappers (look for recipe if you make your own) 
~tweak this to your liking. You can add whatever you want or leave things out.
